description: AUTHORITATIVE detail for one Kalshi market by ticker (e.g. "KXFED-26OCT-T3.50"), live OR long-settled — Kalshi drops older markets from its live endpoints (they 404 there), and this falls through to Kalshi's historical archive and says which answered in `source`. Returns the rules text (so you know exactly what the market settles on — critical before quoting odds), yes_ask + no_ask prices in cents, last_price, volume, open_interest, expiration date, settlement criteria. Use after kalshi_events / kalshi_event to drill into a specific market, or when you already have a Kalshi ticker. For depth-of-book use kalshi_orderbook.
name: kalshi_market
